label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter 'BenchmarkTest01370' flows directly into Cookie.value via getName(), which is then printed to HTTP response writer without HTML escaping. The inner class Test.doSomething applies escapeHtml() to param, but the actual vulnerable path uses the escaped value only for comparison against session attribute; the printed value comes from cookie.name (which contains unescaped user input), leading to XSS.

evidence.note: Cookie name derived from user input is printed to response without escaping
